name: The steps of the church of S. Lourenço, Macau, with a sketch of columns,
summary: On the left of the inked-in drawing are the distinctive columns (sketched in pencil above) of the 'Sixteen-pillared house', one of the grandest houses in Macau, which overlooked the Praya Grande on the other side.
